search_text: published ZDI-25-1094 ZDI-CAN-28211 Fortinet FortiWeb ApacheCookie_parse Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2025-12-16 CVE-2025-64447 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-64447 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Fortinet'] ['FortiWeb'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Fortinet FortiWeb. title: Fortinet FortiWeb ApacheCookie_parse Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Fortinet FortiWeb. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ApacheCookie_parse method. The issue results from the lack of proper verification of a cryptographic signature. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
